package main

import (
 "context"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "time"

 "github.com/rectcircle/fn-connect-private-network/internal/ipc"
 "github.com/rectcircle/fn-connect-private-network/internal/model"
)

func main() {
 ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),20*time.Second)
 defer cancel()
 socket, mode:=os.Args[1],os.Args[2]
 prepare:=func()(func(),error){
  if mode=="refuse" {return nil,model.NewError(model.ErrorPermissionDenied,"fixture refusal",false)}
  return cancel,nil
 }
 server:=ipc.Server{SocketPath:socket,OnReady:func(){fmt.Println("ready")},
  Authorize:func(context.Context,ipc.PeerIdentity)error{
   if mode=="deny" {return model.NewError(model.ErrorPermissionDenied,"fixture peer denied",false)}
   return nil
  },
  Handler:ipc.HandlerFunc(func(_ context.Context,request ipc.Request)ipc.Response{
   // Model the released LocalSystem policy: no status access. The decoder,
   // framing, authorization dispatch and response generation are original code.
   if request.Method!="shutdown-client-daemon" {return ipc.Failure(request.ID,model.NewError(model.ErrorPermissionDenied,"only shutdown allowed",false))}
   shutdown,err:=prepare()
   if err!=nil{return ipc.Failure(request.ID,err)}
   // Released shutdown cancels asynchronously; give its response time to flush.
   go func(){time.Sleep(20*time.Millisecond);shutdown()}()
   return ipc.Success(request.ID,nil)
  }),
 }
 // MAINTENANCE_HOOK
 if err:=server.Serve(ctx);err!=nil{fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr,err);os.Exit(1)}
}
